technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Micro-Si PV module.

# Included processes
This dataset includes the most important materials, energy flows and emissions of the manufacturing of one square meter thin-film module in Oerlikon Solar"s "ThinFab". Furthermore it includes the infrastructure of the facility and the transport of the materials.
